qa.q: Find 32 × 3 using 30 × 3 + 2 × 3.
Each tray holds 10 cups. There are 8 trays. How many cups?
qa.e: 10 cups × 8 trays = 80 cups.

qa.q: Ravi says, 'I see 5 rows of 4 flowerpots, so there are 9 pots.' What went wrong?
qa.a: He added instead of multiplying; it is 20
qa.e: Equal rows mean multiply: 5 × 4 = 20, not 5 + 4.

qa.q: Coins are placed ₹5, ₹2, ₹5, ₹2, ₹5, ₹2, ₹5, ₹2. What is the total?
A pattern ₹10, ₹10, ₹5 repeats 3 times. What is the total?
Which set of coins makes exactly ₹36?
Hari makes ₹125 using only ₹10 and ₹5 coins, with as many ₹10 coins as possible. How many ₹10 coins does he use?
Gauri lays coins as ₹2, ₹1, ₹2, ₹1, ... with 10 coins in all. What is the total?
qa.e: 10 coins make 5 groups of ₹2 + ₹1 = ₹3. 5 × ₹3 = ₹15.

qa.q: ₹183 is made with ₹10 coins, one ₹2 coin and one ₹1 coin. How many ₹10 coins?
Why is it faster to count a repeating coin pattern by groups?
qa.a: You add one group and multiply by the number of groups
qa.e: Finding one group and multiplying saves adding every coin.

qa.q: Nisha has three ₹10 coins, two ₹5 coins and four ₹1 coins. How much money does she have?
12 children make pairs. How many are left without a partner?
qa.e: 12 = 6 pairs exactly, so none are left. 12 is even.

qa.q: 15 coins are put in pairs. How many coins are left over?
qa.e: 7 pairs use 14 coins. 15 − 14 = 1 left over, so 15 is odd.

qa.q: Which number is odd?
qa.e: 19 = 9 pairs and 1 left over, so it is odd.

qa.q: How many even numbers are there from 1 to 20?
Which number is NOT in the 2-times table?
qa.e: 13 is odd. Every number in the 2-times table is even.

qa.q: Can 17 laddoos be shared equally between 2 brothers with none left?
qa.e: 17 is odd: 8 each uses 16, and 1 is left.

qa.q: 20 bangles are shared equally between 2 sisters. How many does each get?
qa.e: 20 is even. 20 ÷ 2 = 10 each.

qa.q: Mona draws pairs for 9. How many full pairs does she draw?
qa.e: 4 pairs use 8. 1 is left over, so 9 is odd.

qa.q: Which digits can an even number end in?
qa.e: Even numbers end in 0, 2, 4, 6 or 8.

qa.q: Is 5,673 even or odd?
qa.e: Its ones digit is 3, which is odd. So 5,673 is odd.

qa.q: Which of these big numbers is even?
qa.e: 1,358 ends in 8, an even digit.

qa.q: A book is open. The page on the left is 34. What is the page on the right?
qa.e: Pages go in order, so the next page after 34 is 35, an odd number.

qa.q: In a book, the right-hand pages are 1, 3, 5, 7... Which page is on the left side?
qa.e: Right pages are odd, so left pages are even. 48 is even.

qa.q: Tara circles odd numbers and puts squares around even numbers in 12, 25, 40, 63, 78. How many circles does she draw?
qa.e: Odd numbers are 25 and 63: 2 circles.

qa.q: Which of these 4-digit numbers is odd?
qa.e: 3,005 ends in 5, which is odd.

qa.q: Raju says 8,641 is even because 8 is even. Is he right?
qa.a: No, the ones digit 1 is odd, so 8,641 is odd
qa.e: Only the ones digit decides. 1 is odd, so 8,641 is odd.

qa.q: How many 2-digit numbers can you make from 3, 4 and 7 without repeating a digit?
qa.e: Each of 3 tens digits can go with 2 different ones digits: 3 × 2 = 6. They are 34, 37, 43, 47, 73, 74.

qa.q: Using 3, 4 and 7 without repeating, how many of the 2-digit numbers are even?
qa.e: Only numbers ending in 4 are even: 34 and 74.

qa.q: Using the digits 5 and 6 once each, which 2-digit number is even?
qa.e: 56 ends in 6, which is even.

qa.q: With the digits 1, 2 and 9 (no repeats), which number is odd?
qa.e: 29 ends in 9, so it is odd.

qa.q: Which digit must go in the ones place to make an even number from 7 and 8?
qa.e: The ones digit must be even, so 8 goes there: 78.

qa.q: Using 2, 5 and 8 without repeating, what is the biggest even 2-digit number?
qa.e: Even numbers must end in 2 or 8. The biggest is 82 (85 is odd).

qa.q: Using 1, 3 and 5 without repeating, how many even 2-digit numbers can you make?
qa.e: All the digits are odd, so every number ends in an odd digit. No even numbers.

qa.q: Ria makes 2-digit numbers from 4 and 9 using each once. She makes 49 and 94. Which statement is true?
qa.e: 49 ends in 9 (odd). 94 ends in 4 (even).

qa.q: What are the two neighbours of 63?
qa.e: Just before is 62 and just after is 64. Both are even because 63 is odd.

qa.q: How many odd numbers are there from 1 to 100?
qa.e: Odd and even take turns, so half of the 100 numbers, 50, are odd.

qa.q: 40 is even. What kind of number is 41?
qa.e: The number after an even number is odd.

qa.q: Which pattern is correct for 15, 16, 17, 18?
qa.e: 15 is odd, 16 even, 17 odd, 18 even. They take turns.

qa.q: The neighbours of a number are 89 and 91. What is the number, and is it even or odd?
qa.e: The number between 89 and 91 is 90, which is even.

qa.q: How many even numbers are there from 1 to 10?
qa.e: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10: five even numbers.

qa.q: Mani writes 3 numbers in a row: an even, then an odd, then ___. What comes next?
qa.e: Counting numbers alternate, so after odd comes even.

qa.q: Are the numbers just before and after 500 even or odd?
qa.e: 499 and 501 are both odd because 500 is even.

qa.q: What comes next? 5, 10, 15, 20, ?
qa.e: Each number is 5 more than the one before. 20 + 5 = 25.

qa.q: What comes next? 3, 7, 11, 15, ?
qa.e: The rule is add 4. 15 + 4 = 19.

qa.q: What comes next? 50, 45, 40, 35, ?
qa.e: The numbers go down by 5 each time. 35 - 5 = 30.

qa.q: What comes next? 2, 4, 8, 16, ?
qa.e: Each number is double the one before. 16 × 2 = 32.

qa.q: Find the missing number: 100, 200, 300, ?, 500
qa.e: The numbers go up by 100. After 300 comes 400.

qa.q: Riya saves ₹10 on Day 1, ₹20 on Day 2 and ₹30 on Day 3. If the pattern goes on, how much does she save on Day 5?
qa.e: She saves ₹10 more each day: ₹40 on Day 4 and ₹50 on Day 5.

qa.q: What comes next? 1, 3, 6, 10, ?
qa.e: The jumps grow by 1 each time: +2, +3, +4, so next is +5. 10 + 5 = 15.

qa.q: What comes next? 9, 18, 27, 36, ?
qa.e: This is the 9 times table. 36 + 9 = 45.

qa.q: Which shape comes next? Triangle, circle, triangle, circle, triangle, ?
qa.e: The core is triangle, circle. After a triangle comes a circle.

qa.q: Aisha's bead string goes red, red, blue, red, red, blue... What colour is the 9th bead?
qa.e: The core has 3 beads. 9 ÷ 3 = 3, so the 9th bead is the end of a core, which is blue.

qa.q: How many beads are in the core of this pattern? 🟡🟢🟢🟡🟢🟢🟡🟢🟢
qa.e: 🟡🟢🟢 repeats again and again. It has 3 beads.

qa.q: Kabir makes squares of tiles: 1 by 1, then 2 by 2, then 3 by 3. How many tiles does the 4 by 4 square need?
qa.e: A 4 by 4 square has 4 rows of 4 tiles. 4 × 4 = 16.

qa.q: Arjun makes triangles in a row with matchsticks. 1 triangle uses 3 sticks, 2 triangles use 5 sticks, 3 triangles use 7 sticks. How many sticks for 4 triangles?
qa.e: Each new triangle shares one stick, so it needs only 2 more sticks. 7 + 2 = 9.

qa.q: A growing pattern has 2 stars, then 4 stars, then 6 stars. How many stars are in the 5th step?
qa.e: Each step adds 2 stars: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10. The 5th step has 10.

qa.q: A rangoli tile turns a quarter turn at each step. How many quarter turns bring it back to how it started?
qa.e: 4 quarter turns make one full turn, so the tile is back where it began.

qa.q: Meena's bangles go gold, silver, silver, gold, silver, silver... How many silver bangles are in the first 12?
qa.e: Each core of 3 bangles has 2 silver. 12 bangles make 4 cores, so 4 × 2 = 8 silver.

qa.q: What is the rule of this pattern? 4, 8, 12, 16
The rule is 'start at 7 and add 3'. What is the 4th number?
qa.e: 7, 10, 13, 16. The 4th number is 16.

qa.q: Find the missing number: 6, 12, ?, 24, 30
qa.e: The rule is add 6. 12 + 6 = 18, and 18 + 6 = 24 checks out.

qa.q: Which rule works for ALL the numbers? 3, 6, 12, 24
qa.e: 3 × 2 = 6, 6 × 2 = 12, 12 × 2 = 24. 'Add 3' works only for the first step.

qa.q: Joseph adds two odd numbers, like 5 + 7 or 3 + 9. What kind of number does he always get?
qa.e: Odd + odd is always even. 5 + 7 = 12 and 3 + 9 = 12 are both even.

qa.q: What comes next? 1000, 900, 800, ?
qa.e: The rule is take away 100. 800 - 100 = 700.

qa.q: The pattern 11, 22, 33, 44... goes on. What is the 9th number?
qa.e: The pattern is the 11 times table. The 9th number is 11 × 9 = 99.

qa.q: On a calendar, which date is just below 5 in the same column?
qa.e: Each row of a calendar is one week of 7 days. So the date below is 5 + 7 = 12.

qa.q: Donations for the community lunch: Monday ₹345, Tuesday ₹508, Wednesday ₹290, Thursday ₹615. How do we read Tuesday's amount?
qa.e: ₹508 is 5 hundreds, 0 tens and 8 ones: five hundred eight.

qa.q: Donations for the community lunch: Monday ₹345, Tuesday ₹508, Wednesday ₹290, Thursday ₹615. Which day got the biggest donation?
qa.e: 615 has 6 hundreds, more than any other amount.

qa.q: How many hundreds blocks do you need to show 345?
qa.e: In 345, the hundreds digit is 3, so 3 hundreds blocks.

qa.q: A number is shown with 2 hundreds blocks, 9 tens blocks and 0 ones. What is it?
qa.e: 2 hundreds + 9 tens + 0 ones = 200 + 90 = 290.

qa.q: People served at the community lunch: 11 to 12 o'clock: 128 | 12 to 1 o'clock: 264 | 1 to 2 o'clock: 197 | 2 to 3 o'clock: 85. Which slot was the least busy?
qa.e: 85 is the smallest number, so 2 to 3 o'clock was least busy.

qa.q: People served at the community lunch: 11 to 12 o'clock: 128 | 12 to 1 o'clock: 264 | 1 to 2 o'clock: 197 | 2 to 3 o'clock: 85. How many more people came from 12 to 1 than from 11 to 12?
Donations for the community lunch: Monday ₹345, Tuesday ₹508, Wednesday ₹290, Thursday ₹615. How much was donated on Monday and Wednesday together?
Which number has 6 hundreds, 1 ten and 5 ones?
What is the largest 3-digit number you can make with 5, 1 and 8, using each once?
qa.e: Put the biggest digit first: 8, then 5, then 1 → 851.

qa.q: What is the smallest 3-digit number you can make with 6, 0 and 3, using each once?
qa.e: 0 cannot be first. Put the next smallest digit, 3, first, then 0, then 6: 306.

qa.q: Using the digits 2 and 5 (repeats allowed), how many 3-digit numbers less than 300 can you make?
qa.e: Under 300 the hundreds digit must be 2. The tens and ones can each be 2 or 5: 222, 225, 252, 255. That is 4.

qa.q: With digits 1, 4 and 7 (repeats allowed), what is the largest number less than 500?
qa.e: The hundreds digit must be 4 or less, so use 4. Then the biggest tens and ones: 7 and 7 → 477.

qa.q: On a number line from 300 to 400, which number is exactly in the middle?
qa.e: Halfway from 300 to 400 is 300 + 50 = 350.

qa.q: On a number line, a point is 3 small marks after 620. Each mark is 1. What number is it?
Which number is to the LEFT of 512 on a number line?
qa.e: Smaller numbers are to the left. 509 is smaller than 512.

qa.q: How many different 3-digit numbers can be made from 2, 4 and 9 using each digit once?
qa.e: Any of 3 digits first, then 2 left for second, then 1 for third: 3 × 2 × 1 = 6.

qa.q: A school has 3 groups of children: 450, 380 and 270. How many children altogether?
Which number is most sensible for the people watching a big cricket match in a stadium?
qa.e: A big stadium holds many thousands of people.

qa.q: Which number is most sensible for the children in one class?
qa.e: A class usually has about 30 to 45 children.

qa.q: Which of these comes in a quantity greater than 1000?
qa.a: Seats in a big cinema hall complex
qa.e: A cinema complex can have thousands of seats. The others are small numbers.

qa.q: A library has 650 storybooks and 480 science books. Does it have more than 1000 books?
qa.e: 650 + 480 = 1130, which is more than 1000.

qa.q: Village A has 520 people and village B has 480 people. How many people in both?
Which number is sensible for the pages in a thick dictionary?
qa.e: A thick dictionary has more than 1000 pages, so about 1200 makes sense.

qa.q: Four buses bring 280, 300, 250 and 220 visitors to a mela. How many visitors?
What number makes 1000 with 850?
What is 1000 − 760?
Which pair does NOT make 1000?
Tina has ₹1000. She spends ₹435. How much is left?
On a number line from 0 to 1000, a frog jumps to 300. How far must it jump to reach 1000?
1000 = 10 hundreds. If you take away 3 hundreds, how many hundreds are left?
qa.e: 10 − 3 = 7 hundreds, which is 700.

qa.q: A 1000-page book: Ravi has read 680 pages. How many pages are left?
Which number is missing? 1000 = 250 + ___
What number is 35 tens?
qa.e: Each ten is 10, so 35 tens = 35 × 10 = 350.

qa.q: Ali circles groups of 10 in a picture of 63 marbles. How many full groups does he circle?
qa.e: 63 = 6 tens and 3 ones, so 6 groups of 10.

qa.q: What number is 15 tens and 23 ones?
Sticks are tied in bundles of 100. How many bundles make 1000 sticks?
qa.e: 10 hundreds = 1000, so 10 bundles.

qa.q: What number is 86 tens?
What number is 2 hundreds, 13 tens and 7 ones?
Which is the same as 4 hundreds and 12 tens?
Ria has 57 ones. She regroups them into tens and ones. What does she get?
qa.e: 57 = 50 + 7 = 5 tens and 7 ones.

qa.q: What is 999 + 1?
qa.e: 999 is the biggest 3-digit number. One more makes 1000, the smallest 4-digit number.

qa.q: How many hundreds make 1 thousand?
qa.e: 100 + 100 + ... ten times = 1000. So 10 hundreds make 1 thousand.

qa.q: Write 'three thousand four hundred five' in numerals.
qa.e: 3 thousands, 4 hundreds, 0 tens and 5 ones make 3405.

qa.q: How do we read 6080?
qa.e: 6080 has 6 thousands, 0 hundreds, 8 tens and 0 ones. That is six thousand eighty.

qa.q: What is 1 more than 4999?
qa.e: 4999 + 1 = 5000. All the 9s turn to 0s and the thousands digit goes up by 1.

qa.q: What is 100 more than 2950?
qa.e: Adding 100 adds 1 to the hundreds. 9 hundreds + 1 hundred = 10 hundreds = 1 thousand. So 2950 becomes 3050.

qa.q: Arjun counts on by thousands: 2345, 3345, 4345, ? What comes next?
qa.e: Each time the thousands digit goes up by 1. 4345 + 1000 = 5345.

qa.q: What is the smallest 4-digit number?
qa.e: 999 has only 3 digits. The first number with 4 digits is 1000.

qa.q: What is the place value of 7 in 4725?
qa.e: The 7 is in the hundreds place, so it is worth 7 × 100 = 700.

qa.q: What number is 5000 + 300 + 20 + 6?
qa.e: 5 thousands, 3 hundreds, 2 tens and 6 ones make 5326.

qa.q: Which digit is in the tens place of 8309?
qa.e: 8309 = 8 thousands, 3 hundreds, 0 tens, 9 ones. The tens digit is 0.

qa.q: What number has 3 thousands, 0 hundreds, 4 tens and 7 ones?
qa.e: Write each digit in its place: 3 | 0 | 4 | 7 = 3047.

qa.q: Which is the expanded form of 6158?
qa.e: 6 thousands = 6000, 1 hundred = 100, 5 tens = 50, 8 ones = 8.

qa.q: Meena has two ₹1000 notes, five ₹100 notes and three ₹10 notes. How much money does she have?
Which number has 9 in the hundreds place?
qa.e: In 2934 the places are 2 thousands, 9 hundreds, 3 tens, 4 ones.

qa.q: How many tens are there in 1000?
qa.e: 10 tens make 100, and 10 hundreds make 1000. So 1000 has 10 × 10 = 100 tens.
Adding 1000 increases the thousands digit by 1: 4,452.
Taking 100 lowers the hundreds digit from 6 to 5: 5,508.

qa.q: What is 7,990 + 10?
qa.e: 9 tens + 1 ten = 10 tens = 1 hundred, so 990 becomes 1000. 7,990 + 10 = 8,000.

qa.q: Rekha has 3 thousand tokens, 4 hundred tokens, 0 ten tokens and 6 one tokens. What number is it?
Sid has 2 thousand tokens and 14 hundred tokens. What number is that?
Who has more? Arun: 4 thousand tokens and 2 hundred tokens. Bela: 3 thousand tokens and 15 hundred tokens.
A card says '5 thousands, 0 hundreds, 7 tens, 3 ones = 5,703'. What is the correct number?
qa.e: 5000 + 0 + 70 + 3 = 5,073. The card put 7 in the hundreds place.

qa.q: Which number is 1 less than 6,000?
Which number lies between 3,000 and 4,000?
qa.e: 3,654 is bigger than 3,000 and smaller than 4,000.

qa.q: On a line marked 2,000, 3,000, 4,000, where does 2,500 go?
qa.e: 2,500 is 500 more than 2,000 and 500 less than 3,000, so it is halfway.

qa.q: Marks are every 100: 7,100, 7,200, 7,300. A point is halfway between 7,200 and 7,300. About what number is it?
qa.e: Halfway between 7,200 and 7,300 is 7,250.

qa.q: Which number is to the right of 5,600 on a number line?
qa.e: Numbers to the right are bigger. 5,610 > 5,600.

qa.q: A number line goes from 8,990 to 9,010. A point is 4 marks after 9,000, each mark being 1. What is it?
How many of these lie between 1,500 and 2,000: 1,499, 1,750, 1,999, 2,001?
qa.e: 1,750 and 1,999 lie between. 1,499 is too small; 2,001 is too big.

qa.q: A point is about one quarter of the way from 6,000 to 7,000. Which is the best estimate?
qa.e: A quarter of 1,000 is 250, so about 6,000 + 250 = 6,250.

qa.q: Which numbers come between 4,998 and 5,002?
Which arrow cards make 2,704?
How do we write 6,049 in words?
qa.e: 6,049 = 6000 + 40 + 9, with no hundreds: six thousand forty-nine.

qa.q: Write 'seven thousand five' in numerals.
qa.e: Seven thousand and 5 ones, with no hundreds or tens: 7,005.

qa.q: Find me: I am the smallest 4-digit number. Who am I?
qa.e: 1,000 is the smallest number with 4 digits.

qa.q: Find me: I have 4 digits, all the same, and I am between 4,000 and 5,000.
qa.e: Numbers with 4 same digits are 1,111, 2,222 ... Only 4,444 is between 4,000 and 5,000.

qa.q: Find me: I am the largest 4-digit number with all different digits.
qa.e: Use the biggest different digits in order: 9, 8, 7, 6 → 9,876.

qa.q: Which number name matches 8,320?
Ravi stacks arrow cards 4000, 80 and 5. What number does he make?
qa.e: 4000 + 80 + 5 = 4,085. There is no hundreds card, so the hundreds digit is 0.

qa.q: Which number is greater: 4567 or 4657?
qa.e: The thousands are the same. In the hundreds, 6 > 5, so 4657 is greater.

qa.q: Which is the largest? 3098, 3890, 3809, 3980
qa.e: All have 3 thousands. The hundreds digits are 0, 8, 8, 9. 3980 has 9 hundreds, so it is the largest.

qa.q: Use the digits 5, 2, 8 and 1 once each. What is the largest 4-digit number you can make?
qa.e: Put the digits from biggest to smallest: 8, 5, 2, 1. That makes 8521.

qa.q: Use the digits 5, 2, 8 and 1 once each. What is the smallest 4-digit number you can make?
qa.e: Put the digits from smallest to biggest: 1, 2, 5, 8. That makes 1258.

qa.q: Which sign goes in the box? 7001 ☐ 7010
qa.e: Thousands and hundreds are the same. Tens: 0 < 1, so 7001 < 7010.

qa.q: Riya's school has 1450 students. Arjun's school has 1405 students. How many more students are in Riya's school?
Which number comes just before 6000?
qa.e: Just before means 1 less. 6000 - 1 = 5999.

qa.q: Which list goes from smallest to largest?
qa.e: Compare the hundreds: 0 < 4 = 4 < 5. Then 2405 < 2450 because 0 tens < 5 tens.

qa.q: Mountain heights: Everest 8,849 m, Kangchenjunga 8,586 m, Nanda Devi 7,816 m. Which is the shortest?
qa.e: Nanda Devi has 7 thousands; the others have 8. So it is the shortest.

qa.q: School cricket season runs: Arjun 1,345, Kabir 1,435, Sameer 1,354. Who scored the most?
qa.e: All have 1 thousand. Hundreds: 3, 4, 3. Kabir has 4 hundreds, the most.

qa.q: Which sign is correct? 5000 + 200 + 7  ☐  5,270
Which sign is correct? 3 thousands 8 tens  ☐  3,080
qa.e: 3 thousands 8 tens = 3000 + 80 = 3,080. They are equal.

qa.q: Which digit makes 6,☐25 < 6,325 true?
qa.e: The hundreds digit must be less than 3, so 2 works.

qa.q: What is the smallest digit that makes 2,4☐9 > 2,469?
qa.e: The tens digit must be more than 6, so the smallest is 7.

qa.q: Prices: a fridge ₹9,450, a TV ₹9,045, a cooler ₹9,504. Which list is from cheapest to costliest?
qa.e: 9,045 < 9,450 < 9,504: TV, fridge, cooler.
Write each as a number: 7,060; 7,600; 7,606; 7,066. The largest is 7,606.

qa.q: How many numbers lie strictly between 7,000 and 8,000?
How many numbers lie strictly between 50 and 60?
How many 4-digit numbers can be made from 2, 5, 7, 9 using each digit once?
qa.e: 4 choices for the first digit, 3 for the second, 2 for the third, 1 for the last: 4 × 3 × 2 × 1 = 24.

qa.q: From 1, 3, 6, 8 (each once), how many 4-digit numbers start with 8?
qa.e: After 8, the other 3 digits can be arranged in 3 × 2 × 1 = 6 ways.

qa.q: From 1, 3, 6, 8 (each once), what is the largest number?
qa.e: Put the digits in decreasing order: 8, 6, 3, 1.

qa.q: From 1, 3, 6, 8 (each once), which number comes just after 8,631 in decreasing order?
qa.e: Keep 8, 6 and change the last two: 8,613 is the next biggest.

qa.q: How many numbers are strictly between 999 and 1,001?
qa.e: Only 1,000 lies between them.

qa.q: Tanvi lists numbers made from 2, 4, 6, 8 (each once) and finds 22. What should she do?
qa.a: Check systematically: 6 for each first digit, 24 in all
qa.e: There must be 24. Listing 6 numbers for each first digit shows which ones are missing.

qa.q: A roti is cut into 4 equal parts. Arjun eats 1 part. What fraction of the roti did he eat?
qa.e: The roti has 4 equal parts and Arjun ate 1 of them. That is 1/4.

qa.q: A chikki bar is broken into 3 equal pieces. Meena eats 2 of them. What fraction did she eat?
qa.e: There are 3 equal pieces and she ate 2. So she ate 2/3.

qa.q: How many halves make one whole?
qa.e: A half is 1 of 2 equal parts. Two halves together make the whole.

qa.q: Which of these shows halves?
qa.a: A paper folded into 2 parts that match exactly
qa.e: Halves are 2 EQUAL parts. Only the paper folded so the parts match exactly shows halves.

qa.q: A ribbon is cut into 8 equal pieces. Kabir uses 3 pieces. What fraction of the ribbon is left?
qa.e: 8 - 3 = 5 pieces are left out of 8. That is 5/8.

qa.q: Which is bigger: 1/2 of a roti or 1/4 of the same roti?
qa.e: Cutting into 2 equal parts gives bigger pieces than cutting into 4. So 1/2 is bigger.

qa.q: What does the fraction 3/4 mean?
qa.e: The whole is cut into 4 equal parts and we take 3 of them.

qa.q: A watermelon is cut into 6 equal slices. Aisha and her brother eat 1 slice each. What fraction of the watermelon did they eat?
qa.e: They ate 1 + 1 = 2 slices out of 6 equal slices. That is 2/6.

qa.q: How many quarters make one half?
qa.e: 1/4 + 1/4 = 2/4 = 1/2, so 2 quarters make a half.

qa.q: A bar of chikki is broken into 2 pieces. One is clearly longer. Are they halves?
qa.e: Halves are 2 EQUAL parts. Unequal pieces are not halves.

qa.q: How can you check that two parts of a paper are equal?
qa.a: Place one on top of the other to see if they match
qa.e: If one part fits exactly on the other, they are equal.

qa.q: Raj draws one line across a square through its middle, from one side to the opposite side. How many equal parts does he get?
qa.e: One line through the middle cuts the square into 2 halves.

qa.q: A pizza is cut into 4 equal parts. Sana eats 2 parts. What part of the pizza is that?
qa.e: 2 quarters = 2/4 = 1/2. She ate half.

qa.q: Which way of cutting a round cake gives 4 equal parts?
qa.a: Two straight cuts crossing at the centre at right angles
qa.e: Two cuts through the centre at right angles give 4 equal parts.
4 quarters make one whole.

qa.q: Meena has half an orange. Riya has 2 quarters of the same size orange. Who has more?
qa.e: 2 quarters = 1 half, so they have the same amount.

qa.q: How many different ways shown here cut a rectangle into halves: across the middle, along the middle, corner to corner?
qa.e: All three cuts make 2 equal parts, so all 3 are ways to make halves.

qa.q: Both diagonals of a rectangular sheet are cut. How many parts, and are they quarters?
qa.a: 4 parts, all quarters of the sheet by size
qa.e: The 2 diagonals make 4 triangles. In a rectangle, each triangle has the same area, a quarter.

qa.q: A paper is cut into 4 equal strips. What fraction is one strip?
qa.e: 4 equal strips make quarters. One strip is 1/4.

qa.q: Ankit's half is a long strip. Bina's half is a triangle. Both come from the same size sheets. Who has more paper?
qa.e: Both are halves of equal sheets, so they have the same amount.

qa.q: A piece fits exactly 4 times into a sheet. What part of the sheet is the piece?
qa.e: 4 equal pieces make the whole, so each is 1/4.

qa.q: A piece fits exactly 2 times into a sheet. What part of the whole is it?
qa.e: 2 equal pieces make the whole, so each is 1/2.

qa.q: Which is NOT a way to cut a square into quarters?
qa.e: One diagonal makes only 2 parts: halves, not quarters.

qa.q: A quarter triangle and a quarter strip come from two sheets of the same size. How do they compare?
qa.e: Quarters of equal wholes are equal in size, even if their shapes differ.

qa.q: A cake is shared equally among 6 friends. What fraction does each friend get?
qa.e: 1 of 6 equal parts is 1/6.

qa.q: Which is bigger: a share when a cake is split among 6, or among 8?
qa.e: Fewer people means bigger pieces. 1/6 > 1/8.

qa.q: How many 1/8 pieces make a whole?
qa.e: 8 pieces of 1/8 make 8/8 = 1 whole.

qa.q: Which share is smaller: 1/9 or 1/11 of the same melon?
qa.e: Sharing among 11 makes smaller pieces than sharing among 9.

qa.q: A ribbon is cut into 5 equal pieces. What is each piece called?
qa.e: 1 of 5 equal parts is 1/5, one-fifth.

qa.q: Riya shares 1 mango among herself and 3 friends equally. What fraction does each get?
qa.e: Riya + 3 friends = 4 people. Each gets 1/4.

qa.q: Six friends share a pizza, then two more friends join and it is shared again equally. What happens to each share?
qa.e: More people sharing the same whole means smaller shares: from 1/6 to 1/8.

qa.q: How many 1/5 pieces are needed to make 1 whole?
qa.e: 5 fifths make a whole: 5/5 = 1.

qa.q: What is 1/5 + 1/5?
qa.e: Add the pieces: 1 + 1 = 2. The size stays fifths: 2/5.
3 pieces of eighths make 3/8.

qa.q: A rectangle is cut into 10 equal parts. 7 are shaded. What fraction is shaded?
qa.e: 7 shaded out of 10 equal parts is 7/10.

qa.q: Kavi wants to shade 2/3 of a strip. How should he do it?
qa.a: Cut into 3 equal parts and shade 2
qa.e: The bottom number 3 tells the number of equal parts; the top 2 tells how many to shade.

qa.q: Tanvi eats 2/6 of a pizza and Jai eats 3/6. How much did they eat together?
A shape has 8 equal parts and 5 are shaded. What fraction is NOT shaded?
qa.e: 8 − 5 = 3 parts are not shaded: 3/8.

qa.q: Hari pours 1/4 of a jug into a glass, then another 1/4 into the same glass. What part of the jug is in the glass?
qa.e: 1/4 + 1/4 = 2/4. The pieces are still quarters, so only the top number adds.

qa.q: How many parts of a 5-part strip must be shaded to show 1/5 + 2/5?
qa.e: 1/5 + 2/5 = 3/5, so shade 3 parts.

qa.q: Which is the biggest piece?
qa.e: The fewer parts a whole has, the bigger each part. 1/4 is biggest.

qa.q: How many 1/5 pieces join to make a whole strip?
qa.e: 5 fifths make a whole.

qa.q: Which is smaller: 1/3 or 1/10 of the same strip?
qa.e: A strip cut into 10 parts has smaller pieces than one cut into 3.

qa.q: Which list is in order from smallest to biggest?
qa.e: 1/8 is the smallest piece and 1/2 is the biggest.

qa.q: Which sign is correct? 1/6 ☐ 1/5
qa.e: 1/6 is smaller than 1/5 because 6 parts are smaller than 5 parts of the same whole.

qa.q: In a fraction kit, how many 1/8 strips are as long as the whole strip?
qa.e: 8 eighths make the whole.

qa.q: Ria cuts one strip into 3 equal parts and another equal strip into 7 equal parts. Which parts are bigger?
qa.e: Fewer parts means bigger parts. 1/3 > 1/7.

qa.q: Which fraction is between 1/3 and 1/5 in size?
qa.e: 1/3 > 1/4 > 1/5, so 1/4 is between them.

qa.q: A garden has 3 roses and 4 marigolds. What fraction of the flowers are roses?
qa.e: 3 roses out of 3 + 4 = 7 flowers is 3/7.

qa.q: In the same garden (3 roses, 4 marigolds), what fraction are marigolds?
qa.e: 4 marigolds out of 7 flowers is 4/7.

qa.q: A garden plan has 9 beds: 2 rose, 3 lily, 4 marigold. What fraction are lily beds?
qa.e: 3 lily beds out of 9 is 3/9.

qa.q: Gita wants a garden of 8 flowers where 5/8 are sunflowers. How many sunflowers should she plant?
qa.e: 5/8 of 8 flowers = 5 flowers.

qa.q: In Gita's 8-flower garden with 5 sunflowers, the rest are roses. What fraction are roses?
qa.e: 8 − 5 = 3 roses, so 3/8.

qa.q: A garden has 4/10 roses and 3/10 lilies. The rest are tulips. What fraction are tulips?
Do 2/6 + 1/6 + 3/6 make one whole?
A basket has 12 fruits: 5 apples and the rest bananas. What fraction are bananas?
qa.e: 12 − 5 = 7 bananas, so 7/12.

qa.q: A dosa is cut into 4 equal parts. 3 parts have chutney. What fraction has chutney?
qa.e: 3 out of 4 equal parts: 3/4.

qa.q: An order says 2/3 masala and 1/3 plain. How many equal parts should the dosa be cut into?
qa.e: The bottom number is 3, so cut into 3 equal parts.

qa.q: A dosa has 3/8 potato and 1/8 onion. The rest is paneer. What fraction is paneer?
qa.e: 3/8 + 1/8 = 4/8. The whole is 8/8, so paneer is 8/8 − 4/8 = 4/8.

qa.q: A dosa is cut into 6 equal parts: 1 part cheese, 2 parts onion, 3 parts plain. What fraction is onion?
qa.e: 2 out of 6 parts: 2/6.

qa.q: Which order covers the whole dosa?
qa.e: 2/5 + 3/5 = 5/5 = 1 whole. The others are less than a whole.

qa.q: Lata wants 1/4 cheese and 3/4 plain on her dosa. Cut into 4 parts, how many parts are plain?
qa.e: 3/4 means 3 of the 4 parts.

qa.q: A dosa has 5 equal parts. 2 have ghee. What fraction has NO ghee?
qa.e: 5 − 2 = 3 parts without ghee: 3/5.

qa.q: A dosa is 3/8 potato, 1/8 onion and 4/8 paneer. Which topping covers the most?
qa.e: 4/8 is the biggest since all parts are eighths and 4 is the largest top number.

qa.q: Dadi has 12 laddoos. She gives half of them to Riya. How many laddoos does Riya get?
qa.e: Half means 2 equal groups. 12 ÷ 2 = 6.

qa.q: What is one quarter of 20 marbles?
qa.e: A quarter means 4 equal groups. 20 ÷ 4 = 5.

qa.q: What is 1/3 of 15 mangoes?
qa.e: Make 3 equal groups. 15 ÷ 3 = 5 in each group.

qa.q: What is 3/4 of 16 diyas?
qa.e: 1/4 of 16 is 4. 3/4 is three of those groups: 3 × 4 = 12.

qa.q: Harpreet has 18 pencils. She gives 1/3 of them to Joseph. How many pencils does Harpreet have left?
qa.e: 1/3 of 18 is 6, which she gives away. 18 - 6 = 12 are left.

qa.q: Kabir has ₹40. He spends 1/4 of it on a kite. How much does the kite cost?
What is 2/5 of 25 laddoos?
Joseph shares 24 grapes equally among 4 friends. What fraction of the grapes does each friend get?
qa.e: Each friend gets 1 of 4 equal shares, so each gets 1/4 of the grapes. (That is 6 grapes.)

qa.q: 16 sweets are split into 4 equal parts. How many sweets in each part?
To show 1/3 of 15 balloons, how many equal groups should you draw?
qa.e: The bottom number 3 tells how many equal groups to make.

qa.q: What is 1/5 of 10 pencils? Show it by grouping.
qa.e: 10 pencils in 5 equal groups gives 2 in each group.

qa.q: Which is a real-life use of a fraction?
qa.a: Buying half a kilogram of tomatoes
qa.e: Half a kilogram is 1/2 kg, a fraction.

qa.q: 'The school bus will come at quarter past 7.' Which fraction is in this sentence?
qa.e: Quarter past means 1/4 of an hour, which is 15 minutes, after 7.

qa.q: Mili draws 12 stars and circles 1/3 of them. How many stars are circled?
A class of 30 children: 1/5 come by bus. How many come by bus?
Ravi splits 16 sweets so that his 4 friends get 1/4 each. How many does each friend get?
How many centimetres are there in half a metre?
qa.e: 1 metre = 100 cm. Half of 100 cm is 50 cm.

qa.q: How many grams is 1/4 kg?
Aisha buys 1/2 litre of milk. How many millilitres is that?
qa.e: 1 litre = 1000 ml. Half of 1000 ml is 500 ml.

qa.q: How many minutes are there in a quarter of an hour?
qa.e: 1 hour = 60 minutes. 60 ÷ 4 = 15 minutes.

qa.q: How many centimetres is 3/4 of a metre?
Meena buys 2 packets of sugar. Each packet is 1/2 kg. How much sugar is that?
qa.e: Two halves make one whole. 1/2 kg + 1/2 kg = 1 kg.

qa.q: Which is heavier: 1/2 kg of rice or 300 g of dal?
qa.e: 1/2 kg = 500 g, and 500 g is more than 300 g. So the rice is heavier.

qa.q: Joseph has a 1 m ribbon. He cuts it into 4 equal pieces. How long is each piece?
qa.e: Each piece is 1/4 of a metre. 100 cm ÷ 4 = 25 cm.

qa.q: A paper folded into thirds is then folded in half. How many sixths are in one third?
qa.e: Each third is split into 2, so 1/3 = 2/6.

qa.q: Which fraction is equivalent to 1/2?
qa.e: 4/8: 4 is half of 8.
Each time the bottom doubles, the top doubles: 4 × 2 = 8.

qa.q: What does 'equivalent fractions' mean?
qa.a: Fractions that name the same amount
qa.e: Equivalent fractions show the same amount in different ways.

qa.q: Which is equivalent to 1/3?
qa.e: Multiply top and bottom by 2: 1/3 = 2/6.

qa.q: Rina folds a paper in half 2 times and colours 2 parts. What fraction is coloured?
qa.e: 2 folds make 4 parts. 2 of 4 = 2/4 = 1/2.
8 is 4 × 2, so the top is 1 × 2 = 2.

qa.q: Which pair is NOT equivalent?
qa.e: 3/6 is a half, but 1/3 is less than a half. So they are not equal.

qa.q: How many 1/4 pieces make 1/2?
qa.e: On the chart, two quarters cover one half.

qa.q: How many 1/8 pieces make 1/4?
qa.e: Two eighths cover one quarter.

qa.q: How many 1/10 pieces make a whole?
qa.e: Ten tenths make one whole.

qa.q: Which is bigger: 2/3 or 1/2?
qa.e: On the chart, 2/3 reaches further than 1/2.

qa.q: Is three 1/6s the same as two 1/8s?
qa.e: Three 1/6s = 1/2 and two 1/8s = 1/4. 1/2 is more.

qa.q: Which smaller pieces combine to make exactly 1/3?
How many 1/8 pieces make 1/2?
qa.e: Two 1/8s make 1/4, and two 1/4s make 1/2. So 4 eighths make a half.

qa.q: Which is equal to 1 whole?
qa.e: 6 sixths = 6/6 = 1 whole.

qa.q: A square is cut into 9 equal small squares. 4 are coloured. What fraction is coloured?
qa.e: 4 coloured out of 9 equal parts: 4/9.

qa.q: A rectangle has 3 parts: one big half and two small quarters. One quarter is shaded. What fraction is shaded?
qa.e: The parts are not equal. Split the half into 2 quarters: 4 equal parts, 1 shaded = 1/4.

qa.q: To show 5/8 of a circle, what should you do?
qa.a: Cut into 8 equal parts and shade 5
qa.e: Bottom number 8 gives the equal parts; top number 5 gives how many to shade.

qa.q: Rohan says a shape cut into 4 unequal parts with 1 shaded shows 1/4. What is wrong?
qa.e: Fractions need equal parts. Unequal parts cannot show 1/4.

qa.q: A strip has 10 equal parts. 3 are red and 2 are blue. What fraction is coloured?
qa.e: 3 + 2 = 5 coloured parts out of 10: 5/10.

qa.q: A hexagon is split into 6 equal triangles. 2 are shaded. What fraction is NOT shaded?
qa.e: 6 − 2 = 4 not shaded: 4/6.

qa.q: How should you divide a square to shade 1/4 of it?
qa.e: 1/4 means 1 of 4 equal parts.

qa.q: A circle has 12 equal parts. 9 are shaded. What fraction is shaded?
qa.e: 9 of 12 equal parts: 9/12.

qa.q: 'How deep is the well?' asks about which measurement?
qa.e: How deep means depth, the distance down.

qa.q: Which tool is best to measure the length of a pencil?
qa.e: A pencil is short, so a small scale works best.

qa.q: A tailor measures the round waist of a customer. Which tool does she use?
qa.e: A soft tape can bend around curved things.

qa.q: Which of these is NOT a measure of length?
qa.e: Temperature tells how hot or cold, not how long.

qa.q: 'How wide is the window?' Which word is used for how wide something is?
qa.e: How wide is the breadth.

qa.q: A metre stick is how long?
qa.e: A metre stick is 1 m, which is 100 cm.

qa.q: Ramu wants to know how hot his milk is. What does he measure?
qa.e: Hot or cold is temperature.

qa.q: Which is the best tool to measure the length of the school corridor?
qa.e: A long corridor needs a long measuring tape.

qa.q: Long jumps: Ravi 210 cm, Sita 185 cm, Tara 225 cm. Who jumped the shortest?
qa.e: 185 is the smallest, so Sita's jump was shortest.

qa.q: In the same contest, how much longer was Tara's jump than Sita's?
Naren marks 10 m on the ground. How many 1 m lengths is that?
qa.e: 10 m is ten lengths of 1 m.

qa.q: Jaya guessed her classroom is 10 m long. She measured 8 m. How far off was her guess?
A classroom is 9 m long and 7 m wide. How much longer is its length than its breadth?
A child crawls 5 m, then walks another 5 m. How far did the child go?
Why do we write each jump in a table?
qa.a: To compare jumps and find the longest and shortest
qa.e: A table keeps all the measurements in one place so we can compare them.

qa.q: Jumps: Mohan 1 m 95 cm, Leena 2 m. Who jumped longer and by how much?
qa.e: 2 m = 200 cm. 200 − 195 = 5 cm. Leena jumped longer.

qa.q: A bus is 12 m long. A crocodile is half as long. How long is the crocodile?
qa.e: Half of 12 m is 12 ÷ 2 = 6 m.

qa.q: An ostrich is 2 m tall. A giraffe is 3 times as tall. How tall is the giraffe?
A cricket bat is 1 m. A whale is as long as 20 bats. How long is the whale?
A stool is 45 cm tall. A box of 35 cm is put on it. How tall is the stack?
A table is 75 cm tall. A pot of 30 cm is kept on it. Is the top of the pot higher than a 1 m stick standing next to it?
A snake is 3 m long. A lizard is 30 cm long. How many lizards laid end to end are as long as the snake?
Three bricks, each 10 cm high, are stacked. How tall is the stack?
A train coach is 20 m long. A car is 4 m long. How many cars fit along one coach?
Meena's plait is 45 cm long. How much shorter is it than 1 m?
Riya has a 3 m rope. She cuts off 120 cm for a swing. How much rope is left?
Kabir runs 5 rounds of a 100 m track. How far does he run?
qa.e: 5 rounds of 100 m is 5 × 100 = 500 m.

qa.q: Arjun is 1 m 32 cm tall. His sister is 1 m 18 cm tall. How much taller is Arjun?
Aisha joins 4 garland pieces, each 60 cm long. What is the total length?
Joseph's desk is 1 m long. How many 25 cm long books fit end to end along it?
Harpreet walks 650 m to school and then 650 m back home. How far does she walk in all?
Meena has a 75 cm ribbon and a 50 cm ribbon. What is their total length?
How many centimetres make 1 metre?
qa.e: 1 metre is the same as 100 centimetres.

qa.q: Which unit is best to measure the length of a pencil?
qa.e: A pencil is short, so we use centimetres. Kilogram measures weight and litre measures liquid.

qa.q: How many centimetres are there in 3 m?
qa.e: Each metre is 100 cm. 3 × 100 = 300 cm.

qa.q: Which rope is longer: one that is 1 m long or one that is 90 cm long?
qa.e: 1 m = 100 cm, and 100 cm is more than 90 cm.

qa.q: A cloth piece is 400 cm long. How many metres is that?
qa.e: 100 cm make 1 m, so 400 cm make 400 ÷ 100 = 4 m.

qa.q: Kabir's ruler is 30 cm long. How many such rulers placed end to end make exactly 3 m?
Riya is 1 m 30 cm tall. What is her height in centimetres?
Which length is the longest?
qa.e: Change all to cm: 2 m = 200 cm, 199 cm, 250 cm, 1 m 90 cm = 190 cm. 250 cm is the longest.

qa.q: How many centimetres are in a quarter metre?
Which is three-quarters of a metre?
Lengths: pencil 14 cm, eraser 4 cm, crayon 9 cm. Which list is shortest to longest?
Which is about 1 cm long?
qa.e: A peanut is about 1 cm.

qa.q: A scale shows one end of a leaf at 0 and the other end at 7. How long is the leaf?
qa.e: Starting at 0, the end mark gives the length: 7 cm.

qa.q: Mira has half a metre of lace and needs 75 cm. How much more lace does she need?
qa.e: Half a metre = 50 cm. 75 − 50 = 25 cm.

qa.q: Two quarter-metre strips are joined. How long is the joined strip?
qa.e: 25 + 25 = 50 cm, which is half a metre.

qa.q: Which is longest: 3/4 m, 70 cm, half a metre?
qa.e: 3/4 m = 75 cm, more than 70 cm and 50 cm.

qa.q: What is the best estimate for the height of a classroom door?
qa.e: A door is a little taller than a grown-up, which is about 2 m.

qa.q: What is the best estimate for the length of an eraser?
qa.e: An eraser fits in your palm, so it is only a few centimetres long.

qa.q: Riya's handspan is about 15 cm. Her table is 6 handspans long. About how long is the table?
qa.e: 6 handspans of 15 cm each is 6 × 15 = 90 cm.

qa.q: Arjun's step is about 50 cm long. About how many steps will he take to walk 5 m?
Which of these is closest to 1 m long?
qa.e: A cricket bat is a little less than 1 m long. The others are much smaller or much bigger.

qa.q: Kabir guessed that his book was 40 cm long. He measured it and it was 32 cm. How far off was his guess?
qa.e: 40 - 32 = 8 cm. His guess was 8 cm too long.

qa.q: Which of these would you measure in metres?
qa.e: A cricket pitch is long, about 20 m. The others are small and are measured in cm or smaller.

qa.q: A cricket pitch is about 20 m long. Meena walks along it 3 times. About how far does she walk?
A broken scale starts at 2 cm. A crayon goes from 2 to 10. How long is the crayon?
A toy car starts at the 15 cm mark and stops at the 62 cm mark on a tape. How far did it roll?
Car A rolls 48 cm down a ramp. Car B rolls 39 cm. How much further did car A go?
On a treasure map each step is 1 cm. Route 1: 4 cm + 3 cm + 2 cm. Route 2: 5 cm + 5 cm. Which is shorter?
qa.e: Route 1 = 9 cm, Route 2 = 10 cm. Route 1 is shorter.

qa.q: How long is route 4 cm + 6 cm + 5 cm on the map?
A ribbon lies on a broken scale from 7 cm to 19 cm. How long is it?
Why can't you just read the end number on a broken scale?
qa.a: The object does not start at 0
qa.e: The object starts at a mark that is not 0, so you must subtract the start.

qa.q: A toy car rolls 25 cm from a low ramp and 40 cm from a high ramp. How much further from the high ramp?
How many 20 cm pieces can be cut from a 2 m rope?
On a number line marked 0 m, 1 m, 2 m, where is 1 m 50 cm?
qa.e: 1 m 50 cm is 50 cm more than 1 m and 50 cm less than 2 m.

qa.q: Three wells are 305 cm, 3 m 50 cm and 3 m 5 cm deep. Which two are equally deep?
Which is the same as 450 cm?
A number line goes 100 cm, 120 cm, 140 cm, ? What is the next mark?
qa.e: It goes up by 20 cm each time: 140 + 20 = 160.

qa.q: How many 50 cm pieces can be cut from a 3 m cloth?
A well is 6 m 8 cm deep. How many cm is that?
Rita cuts 15 cm pieces from a 90 cm ribbon. How many pieces?
Heights: Rina 132 cm, Sonu 1 m 25 cm, Tia 1 m 40 cm. Who is the tallest?
qa.e: Tia: 140 cm is the biggest.

qa.q: In that group, how much taller is Tia than Sonu?
A class records: 95 cm, 104 cm, 99 cm, 112 cm, 101 cm. How many children are taller than 1 m?
qa.e: Taller than 100 cm: 104, 112, 101. That is 3.

qa.q: How should you stand to measure your height correctly?
qa.a: Stand straight against a wall with feet flat
qa.e: Standing straight with heels on the floor gives the true height.

qa.q: Asha is 1 m 18 cm tall. What is her height in cm?
Heights: 120 cm, 97 cm, 108 cm. Who is the shortest?
qa.e: 97 is the smallest number.

qa.q: Ravi was 110 cm tall last year. Now he is 1 m 17 cm. How much did he grow?
Heights: 98 cm, 1 m 2 cm, 99 cm, 1 m 10 cm. How many are shorter than 1 m?
qa.e: 98 cm and 99 cm are shorter than 100 cm.

qa.q: A rectangle is 7 cm long and 4 cm wide. What is its perimeter?
A square garden has sides of 9 m. How much fencing goes around it?
A garden is lined with bricks: 10 bricks on each long side and 6 on each short side. How many bricks in all on the boundary? (No brick is shared at the corners.)
What is perimeter?
qa.a: The total length around a shape
qa.e: Perimeter is the length of the boundary.

qa.q: A triangle has sides 6 cm, 8 cm and 10 cm. What is its perimeter?
Gopal guessed his book's perimeter is 100 cm. He measured sides of 25 cm and 20 cm. What is the true perimeter?
qa.e: 25 + 20 + 25 + 20 = 90 cm. His guess was 10 cm too much.

qa.q: Lace is put around a square handkerchief of side 30 cm. How much lace is needed?
A rectangular field is 50 m long and 30 m wide. Mohan walks once around it. How far does he walk?
What is the perimeter of a 4 by 2 rectangle on a dot grid?
Which has the same perimeter as a 3 by 3 square?
Garden A: 6 m by 2 m. Garden B: 4 m by 4 m. Garden C: 5 m by 2 m. Which has the smallest boundary?
qa.e: A: 16 m. B: 16 m. C: 14 m. C is smallest.

qa.q: A rectangle has perimeter 20 cm and length 7 cm. What is its width?
qa.e: Length + width = 10. 10 − 7 = 3 cm.

qa.q: Which rectangle does NOT have a perimeter of 20 cm?
Two shapes on a dot grid: an L-shape with perimeter 14 units and a rectangle 5 by 2. Which has the longer boundary?
qa.e: 5 + 2 + 5 + 2 = 14. Both are 14 units.

qa.q: A square has perimeter 20 cm. How long is each side?
qa.e: 4 equal sides: 20 ÷ 4 = 5 cm.

qa.q: How many different rectangles with whole-cm sides have perimeter 12 cm? (Count 2 by 4 and 4 by 2 as the same.)
qa.e: Length + width = 6: 5 by 1, 4 by 2, 3 by 3. That is 3.

qa.q: Trip notice: School trip to Mawlynnong on 14 March. Bus leaves at 7:00 am, returns at 6:00 pm. Cost: ₹250 per child, ₹400 per teacher. How much do 3 children pay?
Trip notice: School trip to Mawlynnong on 14 March. Bus leaves at 7:00 am, returns at 6:00 pm. Cost: ₹250 per child, ₹400 per teacher. How long is the trip from leaving to returning?
qa.e: 7 am to 12 noon is 5 hours, then to 6 pm is 6 more: 11 hours.

qa.q: Trip notice: School trip to Mawlynnong on 14 March. Bus leaves at 7:00 am, returns at 6:00 pm. Cost: ₹250 per child, ₹400 per teacher. How much more does a teacher pay than a child?
Trip notice: School trip to Mawlynnong on 14 March. Bus leaves at 7:00 am, returns at 6:00 pm. Cost: ₹250 per child, ₹400 per teacher. What is the cost for 1 teacher and 2 children?
A bus leaves at 8 am and reaches at 1 pm. How many hours is the journey?
qa.e: 8 am to 12 noon is 4 hours, then 1 more hour to 1 pm: 5 hours.

qa.q: The trip bus returns at 6:00 pm. Lunch is from 1:00 pm to 2:00 pm. How many hours of the trip are left after lunch?
qa.e: From 2 pm to 6 pm is 4 hours.

qa.q: Trip notice: School trip to Mawlynnong on 14 March. Bus leaves at 7:00 am, returns at 6:00 pm. Cost: ₹250 per child, ₹400 per teacher. On which date is the trip?
qa.e: The notice says 14 March.

qa.q: A trip costs ₹250 per child. 10 children go. What is the total cost?
Market price list (per kg): oranges ₹60, pineapple ₹45, ginger ₹120, tomatoes ₹38, potatoes ₹25. How much do 2 kg of oranges cost?
qa.e: Double ₹60 = ₹120.

qa.q: Market price list (per kg): oranges ₹60, pineapple ₹45, ginger ₹120, tomatoes ₹38, potatoes ₹25. How much do 2 kg of pineapple cost?
Market price list (per kg): oranges ₹60, pineapple ₹45, ginger ₹120, tomatoes ₹38, potatoes ₹25. How much do 3 kg of potatoes cost?
Market price list (per kg): oranges ₹60, pineapple ₹45, ginger ₹120, tomatoes ₹38, potatoes ₹25. How much do 3 kg of ginger cost?
Market price list (per kg): oranges ₹60, pineapple ₹45, ginger ₹120, tomatoes ₹38, potatoes ₹25. How much do 2 kg of tomatoes cost?
What does '₹45 per kg' mean?
qa.e: 'Per kg' means for each kilogram.

qa.q: Which is the same as the cost of 3 kg of oranges at ₹60 per kg?
qa.e: 3 kg means ₹60 three times.

qa.q: Lam buys 2 kg of ginger at ₹120 per kg and 1 kg of potatoes at ₹25. How much does he pay?
A bill has: rice ₹65, dal ₹48, oil ₹110. What is the total?
Prices: oranges ₹60, ginger ₹120, potatoes ₹25, tomatoes ₹38. Which items cost exactly ₹145?
Prices: oranges ₹60, pineapple ₹45, tomatoes ₹38, sugar ₹20. Which combination costs exactly ₹163?
A bill says: soap ₹35, toothpaste ₹___, total ₹120. What is the missing price?
A bill: biscuits ₹30, milk ₹54, bread ₹___. Total ₹124. What does the bread cost?
Iba has ₹100. Can she buy pineapple (₹45) and tomatoes (₹38) together?
qa.e: 45 + 38 = 83, which is less than ₹100.

qa.q: Which pair costs exactly ₹100? Prices: ₹62, ₹38, ₹45, ₹65
A shop bill: 2 kg potatoes at ₹25 per kg and 1 kg onions at ₹40. What is the total?
Cost ₹163. Paid ₹200. What is the balance?
For the same ₹163 bill, what is the balance if ₹500 is paid?
Daisy's bill is ₹240. She has one ₹100 note and two ₹50 notes. Is it enough?
A toy costs ₹85. Raju pays ₹100. What change should he get?
Which notes are enough to pay ₹275 with the fewest notes?
qa.e: ₹200 + ₹100 = ₹300, enough for ₹275. The others are less than ₹275.

qa.q: A bill is ₹348. Meera pays ₹400. How much balance does she get?
Sam got ₹15 change after paying ₹100. What was his bill?
qa.e: Bill = paid − change = 100 − 15 = 85.

qa.q: Two children buy the same ₹120 snack box. Anil pays ₹200, Bina pays ₹150. How much more change does Anil get?
A side has corners 1 and 2. The side total is 9. What is the middle number?
Which side totals are possible in the 1 to 6 magic triangle?
qa.e: Smallest corners give 9 and biggest corners give 12. Totals in between can also be made.

qa.q: To make the biggest side total, which numbers go at the corners?
qa.e: Corners count on two sides, so the biggest numbers there make the biggest total.

qa.q: Corners are 4, 5 and 6. The side with corners 4 and 6 must total 12. What is its middle number?
Why is a side total of 13 impossible?
qa.a: Even with 4, 5, 6 at the corners, sides can only reach 12
qa.e: The biggest corners give 12 on each side, so 13 cannot be reached.

qa.q: A side has corners 2 and 5. The side total is 10. What is the middle number?
What is the sum of all the numbers 1 to 6?
To get the smallest side total, where should 6 go?
qa.e: A middle number is counted once, so put the big 6 in a middle to keep totals small.
No carrying is needed. 5 + 4 = 9, 4 + 3 = 7, 3 + 2 = 5, 2 + 1 = 3. So 3579.

qa.q: The village collected 1250 kg of plastic in March and 1475 kg in April. How much plastic is that altogether?
Find the missing number: ___ + 2500 = 6000
qa.e: The missing number is 6000 - 2500 = 3500. Check: 3500 + 2500 = 6000.
2000 + 2000 = 4000. We added 1 extra twice, so take away 2: 3998.

qa.q: Three wards cleaned 1200 m, 350 m and 45 m of drains. How many metres in all?
About how much is 2980 + 4030? Choose the best estimate.
On a school trip, 236 children and 18 teachers go. How many people in all?
qa.e: 236 + 18: ones 6 + 8 = 14, write 4 carry 1; tens 3 + 1 + 1 = 5; hundreds 2. So 254.

qa.q: Singing class: 135 children. Tabla class: 89 children. How many children learn music?
What is 324 + 152?
Pinky has ₹238 in her piggy bank. Her brother has ₹45 more than her. How much does her brother have?
qa.e: 45 more than 238 means 238 + 45 = 283.

qa.q: What is 456 + 378?
Samosas cost ₹125 and juice costs ₹68 for the class party. What is the total?
A bus had 47 children. At the next stop 128 more children got on. How many are on the bus now?
What is 399 + 401?
Estimate 692 − 298 by rounding to the nearest hundred.
qa.e: 692 is about 700 and 298 is about 300. 700 − 300 = 400.

qa.q: Last year 345 children joined the clean-up. This year 512 joined. How many more this year?
What is 452 − 168?
A shop sold 630 kites in 2024 and 475 in 2025. How many fewer in 2025?
Ravi worked out 586 − 412 = 74. His estimate was 200. What does this tell him?
qa.a: His answer is probably wrong; check again
qa.e: 74 is far from 200, so he should recheck. The right answer is 174.

qa.q: What is 91 − 47?
What is 703 − 256?
qa.e: Borrow across the 0: 13 − 6 = 7, 9 − 5 = 4, 6 − 2 = 4. So 447.

qa.q: Village A has 820 households; last year it had 765. Estimate the increase by rounding to tens.

qa.e: No borrowing is needed: 8 - 5 = 3, 7 - 4 = 3, 6 - 3 = 3, 5 - 2 = 3.
Borrow across the zeros: 6000 is 5 thousands, 9 hundreds, 9 tens and 10 ones. 10 - 5 = 5, 9 - 7 = 2, 9 - 4 = 5, 5 - 2 = 3. So 3525.

qa.q: The village has 4500 trees. 1250 of them were planted this year. How many trees are older?
Find the missing number: 8000 - ___ = 3200
qa.e: The missing number is 8000 - 3200 = 4800. Check: 8000 - 4800 = 3200.

qa.q: Riya worked out 5420 - 1385 = 4035. To check, she adds 4035 + 1385. What should she get?
qa.e: If the subtraction is right, adding back gives the start number. 4035 + 1385 = 5420.

qa.q: How much more is 9000 than 6750?
Meena had ₹2000. She spent ₹1345 on cleaning brooms and buckets. How much money is left?
Green village has 1345 people and Blue village has 2678 people. How many people live in both villages?
qa.e: 'Both villages' means add. 1345 + 2678 = 4023.

qa.q: Children collected 3250 bottles. 1875 have been sent for recycling. How many are not yet sent?
qa.e: 'Not yet sent' means what is left. 3250 - 1875 = 1375.

qa.q: 'How many more' in a word problem usually tells you to do what?
qa.e: 'How many more' asks for the difference between two numbers, so we subtract.

qa.q: A village had 2500 plants. Children planted 1200 more, but 300 dried up. How many plants are there now?
The compost pit made 1450 kg of compost in Week 1 and 1650 kg in Week 2. How much more was made in Week 2?
A train has 1200 seats. 875 seats are booked. How many seats are still empty?
qa.e: 1200 - 875 = 325 empty seats.

qa.q: Aisha's village wants to collect 6000 kg of waste for recycling. It has collected 4800 kg. How much more is needed?
School A sent 1235 children and School B sent 1180 children to a cleanliness rally. How many children joined in all?
qa.e: 'In all' means add. 1235 + 1180 = 2415.

qa.q: A storybook has 312 pages. Neha has read 145. How many pages are left?
Arif read 238 pages this month. Bela read 175. Who read more and by how much?
qa.e: 238 − 175 = 63. Arif read more.

qa.q: A library had 450 books. 128 were borrowed and 35 were returned. How many books are in the library now?
A train leaves with 120 people. At station A, 35 get off and 48 get on. How many are on board now?
