A number plus its reverse is always a multiple of which number?
qa.e: ab + ba = 11 × (a + b).

qa.q: Which number gives a reverse-sum of 55?
qa.e: 23 + 32 = 55. Its digits add to 5.

qa.q: Which number gives a reverse-sum of 88?
qa.e: 44 + 44 = 88. Its digits add to 8. (34 gives 77, 45 gives 99, 48 gives 132.)

qa.q: How many 2-digit numbers (with no zero digit) have a reverse-sum of 55?
qa.e: Digits adding to 5 with no zero: 14, 23, 32, 41. That is 4.

qa.q: What is the smallest 3-digit number you can get as a reverse-sum?
qa.e: The sum is 11 × (digit sum). 11 × 9 = 99 is 2-digit; 11 × 10 = 110.

qa.q: Use the rule: what is 38 + 83?
Rani's reverse-sum is 132. What do her digits add to?
qa.e: 132 = 11 × 12, so the digits add to 12 (like 57 + 75).
It goes down by 1,000 each time.

qa.q: On a number line, jumps of 1,000 start at 2,500. Where is the 3rd jump?
Count by 50 from 4,850. What are the next two numbers?
A number line has marks at 1,000, 2,000, 3,000. Where is 2,500?
qa.e: 2,500 is 500 more than 2,000, halfway to 3,000.

qa.q: Practice table (made-up numbers), State A / State B: elephants 6,049 / 3,128; tigers 524 / 785; leopards 1,783 / 1,690. How many elephants are in State B?
qa.e: Find the elephant row and State B: 3,128.

qa.q: Practice table (made-up numbers), State A / State B: elephants 6,049 / 3,128; tigers 524 / 785; leopards 1,783 / 1,690. How many tigers are there in both states together?
A park had 1,690 leopards. Now there are 250 more than that. How many now?
A state now has 3,128 elephants, which is 215 more than the last count. What was the last count?
qa.e: Earlier = now − increase = 3,128 − 215 = 2,913.

qa.q: Practice table (made-up numbers), State A / State B: elephants 6,049 / 3,128; tigers 524 / 785; leopards 1,783 / 1,690. How many more leopards are in State A than in State B?
On a map, you write 524 on State A for tigers. If State A gets 76 more tigers, what number should the map show?
A reserve has 1,200 deer now. Last year it had 135 fewer. How many deer last year?
Practice table (made-up numbers), State A / State B: elephants 6,049 / 3,128; tigers 524 / 785; leopards 1,783 / 1,690. Which animal has the biggest total in both states?
qa.e: Elephants: 6,049 + 3,128 = 9,177. Leopards: 3,473. Tigers: 1,309.

qa.q: A wildlife park counted 1342 deer last year and 1518 deer this year. How many more deer are there this year?
qa.e: 'How many more' means subtract. 1518 - 1342 = 176.

qa.q: One lake has 2465 birds and another has 3178 birds. How many birds are there in both lakes?
Visitors to a tiger reserve in 4 months were 4508, 4580, 4085 and 4805. Which is the largest?
qa.e: All have 4 thousands. Compare the hundreds: 5, 5, 0, 8. 4805 has 8 hundreds, the most.

qa.q: A forest has 3456 trees. What is the place value of 4 in 3456?
qa.e: The 4 is in the hundreds place, so its value is 4 × 100 = 400.

qa.q: A zoo had 2750 visitors in the morning and 1875 in the evening. How many visitors came that day?
A safari park had 3980 visitors in a week. Which is the best estimate?
qa.e: 3980 is only 20 less than 4000, so about 4000 is the best estimate.

qa.q: Three elephant herds have 18, 27 and 15 elephants. How many elephants are there in all?
A tiger reserve wants to plant 5000 saplings. 3275 have been planted. How many are still left to plant?
Park A had 5,320 visitors and Park B had 4,875. How many more visited Park A?
Two parks had 8,000 visitors in all. One park had 4,650. How many visited the other?
A factory made 2,450 bottles of mango juice and 375 more bottles of orange juice. How many orange juice bottles?
Apple juice was 600 bottles less than 2,825. How many apple juice bottles?
Cars: 3,180. Bikes: 1,340 more than cars. How many bikes?
Autos: 1,235 less than 3,180 cars. How many autos?
Bikes 4,520, cars 3,180, autos 1,945. Which order is from least to most?
A park had 3,450 visitors on Saturday. On Sunday it had 1,275 more. How many visitors in both days?
How much are 4 notes of ₹500 and 3 notes of ₹200?
Which is ₹3,405 in words?
qa.a: Three thousand four hundred five rupees

qa.q: Notes: 2 × ₹500, 5 × ₹100, 3 × ₹10. What is the total?
Meera deposits ₹1,850 and later ₹2,375. How much did she deposit in all?
Why must the amount be written in words on a deposit slip?
qa.a: So nobody can change the figures
qa.e: Words are hard to change, so they keep the amount safe.

qa.q: A slip shows 6 notes of ₹200 and 8 coins of ₹10. What is the total?
What is 5,010 + 95?
Which sign is correct? 2,468 + 1,000 ☐ 2,468 + 999
qa.e: Both add to 2,468, but 1,000 > 999.
Subtraction undoes addition: 3,579 − 1,234 = 2,345.
2,340 is 10 more than 2,330, so the sum is 10 more: 6,900.

qa.q: Ravi says 7,000 − 3,456 = 3,544. How can he check?
qa.a: Add 3,544 + 3,456 and see if it makes 7,000
qa.e: Answer + number taken away = starting number. 3,544 + 3,456 = 7,000. ✓

qa.q: What is 3,600 − 99?
Which sign is correct? 6,000 − 250 ☐ 6,000 − 205
qa.e: Taking away more leaves less. 250 > 205, so 6,000 − 250 is smaller.

qa.q: Check: is 8,203 − 4,567 = 3,636 correct?
qa.e: 3,636 + 4,567 = 8,203, so the subtraction is correct.

qa.q: Suppose an elephant drinks 150 litres of water a day. How much does it drink in 4 days?
A zoo elephant is given 125 kg of food each day. How much food is that in 7 days?
A tiger cub naps 15 hours a day. How many hours does it nap in 6 days?
Each safari jeep carries 6 visitors. 35 jeeps go out in a day. How many visitors go on safari?
What is 23 × 12?
A forest guard walks 14 km every day. How far does she walk in 12 days?
A ticket to the leopard safari costs ₹45. How much do 20 children pay altogether?
Which is the same as 16 × 25?
qa.e: 25 = 20 + 5, so 16 × 25 = 16 × 20 + 16 × 5. Each part must be multiplied by 16.

qa.q: A viewing gallery has 4 rows of 25 seats. 63 seats are filled. How many seats are empty?
qa.e: Total seats: 4 × 25 = 100. Empty: 100 - 63 = 37.

qa.q: Safari tickets cost ₹30 for an adult and ₹15 for a child. How much do 2 adults and 3 children pay?
96 bananas are shared equally among 8 elephants. How many bananas does each elephant get?
A forest has 3 lakes with 45 ducks on each lake. 28 ducks fly away. How many ducks are left?
qa.e: 3 × 45 = 135 ducks. 135 - 28 = 107 ducks left.

qa.q: A ranger buys 6 bags of seeds at ₹125 each. He pays with ₹1000. How much change does he get?
A wildlife park gets 1500 visitors each day it is open. It is closed on Mondays. How many visitors come in one week?
qa.e: The park is open 7 - 1 = 6 days. 6 × 1500 = 9000 visitors.

qa.q: 240 saplings are planted in rows of 12. How many rows are there?
In a camp, 5 grown-up elephants eat 150 kg each and 2 baby elephants eat 50 kg each in a day. How much food do they eat in all?
qa.e: Grown-ups: 5 × 150 = 750 kg. Babies: 2 × 50 = 100 kg. Total: 850 kg.

qa.q: How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
qa.e: A square can be folded in half 4 ways: up-down, left-right and along both corner-to-corner lines.

qa.q: How many lines of symmetry does a rectangle that is not a square have?
qa.e: It folds evenly only across the middle in two ways. A corner-to-corner fold does not make the halves match.

qa.q: Which letter has a line of symmetry?
qa.e: A folds down the middle into two matching halves. F, L and N do not match when folded.

qa.q: Which letter has NO line of symmetry?
qa.e: No fold makes the two halves of S match. H, T and E each have at least one line of symmetry.

qa.q: A triangle has all 3 sides equal. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
qa.e: You can fold it from each corner to the middle of the opposite side. That is 3 lines.

qa.q: Which letter has a lying (horizontal) line of symmetry, so its top half matches its bottom half?
qa.e: B folded from top to bottom matches. A, T and V have only a standing line of symmetry.

qa.q: How many lines of symmetry does the capital letter H have?
qa.e: H matches when folded down the middle and when folded across the middle. That is 2 lines.

qa.q: Which of these has the most lines of symmetry?
qa.e: Any fold through the centre of a circle makes matching halves, so a circle has endless lines of symmetry.

qa.q: In an ink-blot design, what is the fold line called?
qa.e: The fold line splits the design into two matching halves.

qa.q: Paint is put on the left half and the paper is folded. Where does the copy appear?
qa.a: On the right half, flipped like a mirror
qa.e: Folding presses the paint onto the other half as a mirror image.

qa.q: Why should both wings of a paper plane be the same?
qa.e: A symmetrical plane balances and flies straight.

qa.q: Which fold is the line of symmetry of a paper plane?
qa.a: The first fold down the middle
qa.e: The middle fold divides the plane into two equal halves.

qa.q: Ankit places a mirror along the middle of half a butterfly drawing. What does he see?
qa.e: The mirror shows the other matching half, so the whole butterfly appears.

qa.q: An ink-blot design has 6 dots on the left half before folding (none on the fold). How many dots after opening?
qa.e: Each dot is copied to the right half: 6 + 6 = 12.

qa.q: A plane drifts to the left every time. What is likely wrong?
qa.e: Unequal (not symmetrical) wings make a plane turn.

qa.q: A mirror is placed on the line of symmetry of half the letter A. What letter do you see?
qa.e: The mirror shows the missing half, completing the A.

qa.q: Riya folds a paper in half and cuts out half a heart along the fold. What does she get when she opens it?
qa.e: The fold is the line of symmetry. Opening it shows both matching halves joined: a whole heart.

qa.q: In a mirror held to its side, what does the letter b look like?
qa.e: A mirror flips left and right. The bump of b moves to the left side, making it look like d.

qa.q: A symmetrical rangoli has 7 dots on the left of the fold line and none on the line. How many dots are in the whole rangoli?
qa.e: The right half is a mirror copy, so it has 7 dots too. 7 + 7 = 14.

qa.q: Which word looks the same in a mirror held to its side?
qa.e: M and O look the same when flipped, and MOM reads the same both ways. B, D, S, N and P do not.

qa.q: Which digit looks the same in a mirror held to its side?
qa.e: 8 has a standing line of symmetry, so its mirror image is the same. 2, 4 and 7 face the other way.

qa.q: Arjun draws the left half of a symmetrical shape. It is 3 squares wide. How wide is the full shape?
qa.e: The right half is the same width as the left half. 3 + 3 = 6 squares.

qa.q: A dot is 4 squares to the left of a mirror line. Where is its mirror dot?
qa.a: 4 squares to the right of the line
qa.e: A mirror dot is the same distance from the line but on the other side.

qa.q: Kabir stands 2 steps in front of a mirror. How far behind the mirror does his image seem to be?
qa.e: Your mirror image always seems to be the same distance behind the mirror as you are in front of it.

qa.q: A paper folded once has a half-circle cut on the fold. What do you see when you open it?
qa.e: The half-circle on the fold opens into one full circle.

qa.q: A paper folded once has a small hole punched away from the fold. How many holes after opening?
qa.e: The punch goes through 2 layers, so 2 holes.

qa.q: A paper folded twice has a hole punched in the middle, away from all folds. How many holes after opening?
qa.e: Two folds make 4 layers, so 4 holes.

qa.q: A paper is folded twice and a quarter circle is cut at the corner where both folds meet. What do you get?
qa.e: The 4 quarter circles join into one circle in the middle.

qa.q: How many layers are there after folding a paper 3 times?
qa.e: Each fold doubles the layers: 2, 4, 8.

qa.q: Maya wants a square hole in the centre. What should she do?
qa.a: Fold twice and cut straight across the folded corner
qa.e: A straight cut across the twice-folded corner opens into a square.

qa.q: A paper is folded once. On the fold, Ravi cuts a rectangle 1 cm wide (from the fold) and 2 cm long (along the fold). What hole does he get?
qa.e: The 1 cm width doubles to 2 cm when opened, so the hole is 2 cm by 2 cm, a square.

qa.q: A paper folded twice has a small notch cut on one folded edge, not at the corner. How many notches or holes after opening?
qa.e: The 4 layers pair up across the fold, making 2 holes.

qa.q: Which number looks exactly the same in a mirror held beside it?
qa.e: 8 and 0 look the same in a mirror, and 808 reads the same from both ends.

qa.q: Why is AMBULANCE written in mirror writing on the van?
qa.a: So drivers ahead can read it in their mirrors
qa.e: A rear-view mirror flips the writing back to normal.

qa.q: How does the number 18 look in a mirror held beside it?
qa.e: 1 and 8 stay the same, but the order is reversed: 81.

qa.q: Which word looks the same in a mirror held beside it?
qa.e: W and O look the same in a mirror, and WOW reads the same both ways.

qa.q: Hema puts a mirror across a heart shape. The heart and its reflection make the same heart. Where is the mirror?
qa.e: When a mirror shows the same shape, it is on the line of symmetry.

qa.q: Which number made of 1s and 0s looks the same in a mirror?
qa.e: 1001 reads the same from both ends, and 1 and 0 look the same in a mirror.

qa.q: Which of these digits does NOT look the same in a mirror held beside it?
qa.e: 3 flips and faces the other way. 0, 8 and 1 stay the same.

qa.q: Sunil writes his name in mirror writing. How should he write?
qa.a: Flip each letter and start from the other side
qa.e: Mirror writing flips each letter left to right and reverses the order.

qa.q: How many lines of symmetry does a regular pentagon have?
qa.e: A regular pentagon has 5 equal sides and 5 lines of symmetry.

qa.q: How many lines of symmetry does a regular hexagon have?
qa.e: Regular shapes have as many lines of symmetry as sides.

qa.q: A square has 4 sides. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
qa.e: 2 lines through the middles of sides and 2 diagonals: 4.

qa.q: Which shape has exactly 2 lines of symmetry?
qa.a: A rectangle that is not a square
qa.e: A rectangle folds in half across and along, but not on its diagonals.

qa.q: A regular octagon has 8 equal sides. How many lines of symmetry?
qa.e: For regular shapes, lines of symmetry = number of sides.

qa.q: On a dot grid, Sara draws a kite shape. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
qa.e: A kite folds into matching halves only along its long middle line.

qa.q: Which is true for regular shapes?
qa.a: Lines of symmetry = number of sides
qa.e: Triangle 3, square 4, pentagon 5, hexagon 6.

qa.q: How many more lines of symmetry does a regular hexagon have than a regular triangle?
In the pattern ■●■●■●, what is the repeating unit?
qa.e: ■● repeats again and again.

qa.q: A tile is moved to the right without turning or flipping. What is this move called?
qa.e: Moving without turning is a slide.

qa.q: A tile with an arrow → becomes ← . Which single move could do this?
qa.e: Flipping like a mirror changes → to ←. A half turn does too.

qa.q: How many quarter turns bring a tile back to how it started?
qa.e: 4 quarter turns make a full turn.

qa.q: What comes next? ▲▲▼▲▲▼▲▲
qa.e: The unit is ▲▲▼, so after ▲▲ comes ▼.

qa.q: In ⭐🌙🌙⭐🌙🌙, how many shapes are in the repeating unit?
qa.e: ⭐🌙🌙 has 3 shapes.

qa.q: A tile is turned a quarter turn each time: ↑ then →. What comes next?
qa.e: Each quarter turn moves the arrow one right angle clockwise: ↑, →, ↓, ←.

qa.q: A floor border uses the unit 🟥🟨🟨. How many 🟨 tiles are in 4 units?
qa.e: Each unit has 2 yellow tiles. 4 × 2 = 8.

qa.q: What does tessellation mean?
qa.a: Covering a surface with shapes with no gaps and no overlaps
qa.e: Tessellating shapes fit together completely.

qa.q: Which shape does NOT tessellate on its own?
qa.e: Circles leave gaps between them.

qa.q: Which shape do bees use in honeycombs?
qa.e: Regular hexagons fit together with no gaps.

qa.q: Two regular triangles are joined side to side. Does the new tile tessellate?
qa.e: They make a rhombus, which fits with copies of itself.

qa.q: A tile shows a flower with 4 equal petals. Is it symmetrical?
qa.e: A flower with 4 equal petals has lines of symmetry.

qa.q: Which is true about a regular pentagon?
qa.a: It leaves gaps when tiled alone
qa.e: Regular pentagons do not fit together without gaps.

qa.q: A floor is covered by 6 rows of 8 square tiles with no gaps. How many tiles?
Leena makes her own tile using a rangoli kit. What must be true for it to tile a floor?
qa.a: Copies fit together with no gaps or overlaps
qa.e: A tessellating tile fits with its copies, leaving no gaps.

qa.q: In the catty-wall trick, where does the cut piece go?
qa.e: The piece is slid to the opposite side so the tiles still fit.

qa.q: After the catty-wall trick, how does the tile's area compare with the square's?
qa.e: Nothing is added or removed; a piece is only moved.

qa.q: Why do the new cat-shaped tiles still fit together?
qa.a: The bump on one side fills the gap on the next tile
qa.e: Each bump matches a gap, so there are no gaps or overlaps.

qa.q: What is a floor pattern made by?
qa.a: Repeating one tile with no gaps
qa.e: A floor pattern repeats a tessellating tile.

qa.q: Tanu cuts a piece from the left side of a square and sticks it on the TOP. What may happen?
qa.a: The tiles may not fit together
qa.e: The piece must slide to the opposite side (right). Moving it elsewhere breaks the fit.

qa.q: A wall needs 5 rows of 7 catty tiles. How many tiles?
A square tile has area 16 small squares. After the catty-wall trick, what is its area?
qa.e: Moving a piece does not change the area.

qa.q: Which shape is the best start for a catty-wall tile?
qa.e: Squares tessellate, so a cut-and-slide square still tessellates.

qa.q: Which part of a butterfly is its line of symmetry?
qa.e: The body divides the butterfly into two matching halves.

qa.q: How can you test if a leaf is symmetrical?
qa.a: Fold it along the middle vein and see if the halves match
qa.e: If the halves match when folded, it is symmetrical.

qa.q: Which is most likely NOT symmetrical?
qa.a: A leaf torn on one side
qa.e: The torn side no longer matches the other side.

qa.q: A flower has 6 equal petals evenly spread. How many lines of symmetry can it have?
qa.e: Like a regular hexagon, it has 6 lines of symmetry.

qa.q: Riya collects 12 leaves. 9 are symmetrical. How many are not?
To make a leaf print card, what should you do?
qa.a: Paint a leaf and press it on paper
qa.e: Painting and pressing makes a print.

qa.q: A leaf print is made on one half of a folded card and the card is pressed shut. What appears on the other half?
qa.a: A mirror image of the print
qa.e: The wet paint copies as a mirror image, like an ink blot.

qa.q: Which animal shows symmetry when seen from the front?
qa.e: A tiger's face has matching left and right halves.

qa.q: How many days are there in March?
qa.e: March is one of the months with 31 days.

qa.q: In a year that is not a leap year, how many days does February have?
qa.e: February is the shortest month. It has 28 days, and 29 only in a leap year.

qa.q: How many days are there in a year that is not a leap year?
qa.e: An ordinary year has 365 days. A leap year has 366.

qa.q: 1 June is a Monday. What day is 8 June?
qa.e: 8 June is 7 days after 1 June. The day of the week repeats every 7 days, so it is Monday again.

qa.q: Today is Friday. What day will it be 3 days from today?
qa.e: Count on: Saturday (1), Sunday (2), Monday (3).

qa.q: How many weeks are there in 28 days?
qa.e: Each week has 7 days. 28 ÷ 7 = 4 weeks.

qa.q: Today is 28 March. Aisha's birthday is on 5 April. How many days does she have to wait?
qa.e: 28 March to 31 March is 3 days, then 5 more days to 5 April. 3 + 5 = 8 days.

qa.q: Which of these months has 30 days?
qa.e: April has 30 days. May, January and August each have 31 days.

qa.q: How many days are there in a leap year?
qa.e: A leap year has one extra day, 29 February: 365 + 1 = 366.

qa.q: 2024 was a leap year. Which year is the next leap year?
qa.e: Leap years come every 4 years: 2024 + 4 = 2028.

qa.q: 2024 was a leap year. Which year was the leap year before it?
How often does a leap year come?
qa.e: One year in every 4 is a leap year.

qa.q: How many days does February have in a leap year?
qa.e: In a leap year, February has 29 days.

qa.q: In which month do we celebrate Independence Day?
qa.e: Independence Day is on 15 August.

qa.q: Children's Day is on 14 November. In which month is it?
qa.e: 14 November is in November.

qa.q: How many leap years are there from 2021 to 2032 (both included)?
qa.e: 2024, 2028 and 2032: 3 leap years.

qa.q: Today is Monday. What day is the day after tomorrow?
qa.e: Tomorrow is Tuesday, the day after is Wednesday.

qa.q: Today is Friday. What was the day before yesterday?
qa.e: Yesterday was Thursday; the day before that was Wednesday.

qa.q: 1 March is a Sunday. March has 31 days. What day is 1 April?
qa.e: 31 days = 4 weeks + 3 days. Sunday + 3 days = Wednesday.

qa.q: 1 April is a Wednesday. April has 30 days. What day is 1 May?
qa.e: 30 days = 4 weeks + 2 days. Wednesday + 2 = Friday.

qa.q: In a year that is not a leap year, 1 February is a Tuesday. What day is 1 March?
qa.e: February has exactly 28 days = 4 weeks, so the weekday stays the same.

qa.q: Today is the 10th. What date was the day before yesterday?
Today is the 27th. What date will the day after tomorrow be?
How many days does the weekday move on from 1 July to 1 August? (July has 31 days.)
qa.e: 31 days is 4 weeks and 3 days, so it moves on 3 days.

qa.q: Asha was born on 12 March 2016. Ravi was born on 20 March 2016. Who is older and by how many days?
qa.e: Same year and month; 12 comes before 20. 20 − 12 = 8 days. Asha is older.

qa.q: Rohit was born in 2014 and his sister in 2019. How many years older is Rohit?
Meena was born on 14 June 2016. On what date is her 10th birthday?
qa.e: Keep the date and month, add 10 to the year: 2016 + 10 = 2026.

qa.q: A juice packet: MFD 1 January, EXP 1 April (same year). How many months is it good for?
qa.e: January to April is 3 months.

qa.q: A medicine: MFD 5 May, EXP 25 May. How many days is it good for?
Bread is made on 3 August. It stays good for 5 more days after that. What is the last good date?
qa.e: 3 + 5 = 8 August.

qa.q: A packet says 'MFD: March 2026. Best before 6 months from MFD.' When does it expire?
qa.e: 6 months after March: Apr, May, Jun, Jul, Aug, Sep. So September 2026.

qa.q: Who is the oldest? Ali: 5 Jan 2016, Bina: 30 Dec 2015, Chetan: 1 Feb 2016.
qa.e: Bina was born in 2015, the earliest year.

qa.q: What is Purnima?
qa.e: Purnima is the full moon night.

qa.q: What is Amavasya?
qa.a: New moon, when we cannot see the moon
qa.e: On Amavasya the moon is not seen.

qa.q: About how many days are there from one Purnima to the next?
qa.e: The moon's cycle takes about 29 to 30 days.

qa.q: About how many days after Amavasya does Purnima come?
qa.e: They are about half a moon cycle apart: about 15 days.

qa.q: Around which English months does the Hindu month Chaitra usually fall?
qa.e: Chaitra usually begins in March and ends in April.

qa.q: Why do Islamic months move to different English dates each year?
qa.a: The Islamic calendar follows the moon
qa.e: A moon year is about 354 days, about 11 days shorter than 365.

qa.q: Diwali falls on which kind of night?
qa.e: Diwali is on Amavasya, which is why lamps light up the dark night.

qa.q: A Purnima is on 10 May. About when is the next Amavasya?
qa.e: Amavasya comes about 15 days after Purnima: 10 + 15 = 25 May.

qa.q: How many hours are there in a day?
qa.e: A full day has 24 hours.

qa.q: How many hours from 6 am to 6 pm?
qa.e: 6 am to 12 noon is 6 hours, then 6 more to 6 pm: 12.

qa.q: How many hours from 6 am today to 6 am tomorrow?
qa.e: That is one full day, 24 hours.

qa.q: Pinky sleeps from 9 pm to 6 am. How many hours does she sleep?
qa.e: 9 pm to 12 midnight is 3 hours; 12 to 6 am is 6 hours. 3 + 6 = 9.

qa.q: Ravi sleeps 10 hours and is at school 6 hours. How many hours are left in the day?
Sita's day: sleep 9 h, school 7 h, homework 2 h, play 2 h, meals 2 h. How many hours is that?
In Sita's day, how many hours are not listed?
A shop is open from 8 am to 8 pm. How many hours is it open?
qa.e: 8 am to 12 noon is 4 h; 12 noon to 8 pm is 8 h. 4 + 8 = 12.

qa.q: School starts at 8:00 am and ends at 1:30 pm. How long is the school day?
qa.e: 8:00 am to 12:00 noon is 4 hours. 12:00 to 1:30 pm is 1 hour 30 minutes. Total: 5 hours 30 minutes.

qa.q: How many minutes are there in 2 hours?
qa.e: 1 hour = 60 minutes. 2 × 60 = 120 minutes.

qa.q: A film starts at 3:15 pm and lasts 2 hours. When does it end?
qa.e: Add 2 hours to 3:15 pm: 4:15 pm, then 5:15 pm. It is still afternoon, so pm.

qa.q: Arjun eats breakfast at 7 o'clock in the morning. How do we write this time?
qa.e: Morning times before noon use am. So it is 7:00 am.

qa.q: A cricket match on TV goes from 2:40 pm to 4:10 pm. How long is it?
qa.e: 2:40 to 3:00 is 20 minutes, 3:00 to 4:00 is 60 minutes, 4:00 to 4:10 is 10 minutes. 20 + 60 + 10 = 90.

qa.q: Riya sleeps at 9:30 pm and wakes up at 6:30 am. How long does she sleep?
qa.e: 9:30 pm to 12:00 midnight is 2 hours 30 minutes. Midnight to 6:30 am is 6 hours 30 minutes. Together: 9 hours.

qa.q: How many hours and minutes is 90 minutes?
qa.e: 60 minutes make 1 hour. 90 - 60 = 30. So 90 minutes = 1 hour 30 minutes.

qa.q: A clock shows 10:45. What time will it be 20 minutes later?
qa.e: 10:45 + 15 minutes = 11:00. 5 more minutes makes 11:05.

qa.q: A digital clock shows 07:45 am. What time is it?
qa.e: 07:45 means 7 hours 45 minutes; am means morning.

qa.q: A digital clock shows 09:05 pm. Which is correct?
qa.e: 09:05 is 9 hours 5 minutes; pm means evening or night.

qa.q: Assembly ends at 8:20 am. Period 1 is 40 minutes long. When does it end?
qa.e: 8:20 + 40 minutes = 8:60, which is 9:00.

qa.q: Lunch starts at 12:30 pm and lasts 30 minutes. Next is art for 45 minutes. When does art end?
qa.e: Lunch ends 1:00 pm. 1:00 + 45 minutes = 1:45 pm.

qa.q: Which task takes about 5 minutes?
qa.e: Brushing teeth takes a few minutes.

qa.q: The bus comes at 7:50 am. The digital clock shows 07:38. How many minutes until the bus comes?
qa.e: 50 − 38 = 12 minutes.

qa.q: Sports starts at 3:15 pm and lasts 50 minutes. When does it end?
qa.e: 15 + 50 = 65 minutes = 1 hour 5 minutes. 3:15 + 50 min = 4:05 pm.

qa.q: Tying both shoes takes about 2 minutes. Packing your bag takes about 5 minutes. How long for both?
qa.e: 2 + 5 = 7 minutes.

qa.q: The short hand is just past 3 and the long hand is on 4. What time is it?
qa.e: The short hand shows 3 o'clock has passed. The long hand on 4 means 4 × 5 = 20 minutes. So it is 3:20.

qa.q: The long hand points to 9. How many minutes past the hour is it?
qa.e: Each number on the clock is 5 minutes for the long hand. 9 × 5 = 45 minutes.

qa.q: What time is 'quarter past 6'?
qa.e: A quarter of an hour is 15 minutes. Quarter past 6 is 15 minutes after 6: 6:15.

qa.q: What time is 'half past 11'?
qa.e: Half an hour is 30 minutes. Half past 11 is 11:30.

qa.q: The clock shows 8:50. How else can we say this time?
qa.e: 8:50 is 10 minutes before 9:00, so it is 10 minutes to 9.

qa.q: How many minutes are there in 1 hour?
qa.e: The long hand goes all the way round once in 60 minutes. That is 1 hour.

qa.q: The short hand is between 4 and 5. The long hand is 2 small marks after the 7. What time is it?
qa.e: The hour is 4. The long hand at 7 means 35 minutes, and 2 more marks make 37. So 4:37.

qa.q: The train leaves at 7 o'clock and 5 minutes. How do we write this time?
qa.e: Minutes are written with two digits. 5 minutes is written as 05, so 7:05.

qa.q: The short hand is on 3 and the long hand is on 12. What time is it?
qa.e: Short hand gives the hour (3); long hand on 12 means 0 minutes.

qa.q: The short hand is halfway between 6 and 7 and the long hand is on 6. Bunty says it is 7:30. What is the right time?
qa.e: Short hand between 6 and 7 → hour 6. Long hand on 6 → 30 minutes. 6:30.

qa.q: The short hand is just before 8. The long hand is on 10. What time is it?
qa.e: The hour hand has not reached 8, so it is still 7. 10 × 5 = 50 minutes.

qa.q: Which hand shows the hour?
qa.e: The short hand points to the hour.

qa.q: The long hand is on 4. How many minutes past the hour is it?
qa.e: 4 × 5 = 20 minutes.

qa.q: At 9:45, where is the hour hand?
qa.a: Most of the way from 9 to 10
qa.e: 45 minutes is three-quarters of an hour, so the hour hand is three-quarters of the way to 10.

qa.q: Rina says the time is 4:12 because the short hand is on 12 and the long hand is on 4. What is the right time?
qa.e: Short hand on 12 → hour 12. Long hand on 4 → 20 minutes. 12:20.

qa.q: The long hand is 3 small marks after the 2. How many minutes past the hour?
qa.e: 2 × 5 = 10, plus 3 small marks = 13 minutes.

qa.e: Rate is the price of one item. Amount = quantity × rate.

qa.e: 3 × 40 = 120, so the bill should say ₹120. The shopkeeper made a mistake.

qa.q: At the transport museum, adult tickets cost ₹50 and child tickets cost ₹20. What is the bill for 2 adults and 3 children?

qa.e: E appears 2 times.

qa.e: There are 7 codes, one per child.

qa.q: Which way of showing data is easier to read: a long list of codes, or a table of counts?
qa.e: A table shows each total at once, so we do not need to count again.

qa.q: Why do we use short codes when recording answers?
qa.e: Codes save time when many people answer.

qa.q: Codes: M M E V M H M. Which subject is the favourite?
qa.e: M appears 4 times, the most.

qa.q: Raju asks 'Do you like food?' Everyone says yes. What is wrong with his question?
qa.a: It does not tell which food they like
qa.e: A yes/no question cannot show favourites. He should list food choices.

qa.e: Mango has the biggest count, 12.

qa.q: How many more children chose mango (12) than apple (5)?
qa.e: 12 - 5 = 7 more children chose mango.

qa.q: Riya wants to know how her classmates come to school. What is the best way to collect this data?
qa.a: Ask each child and make tally marks
qa.e: Asking every child and keeping a tally gives correct, complete data.

qa.q: A table of favourite colours shows Red 9, Blue 6, Green 9, Yellow 4. Which two colours got the same number of votes?

qa.e: 14 + 23 + 9 = 46 vehicles.

qa.q: In Kabir's count (14 cars, 23 bikes, 9 buses), how many fewer buses than bikes were there?
qa.e: 23 - 9 = 14 fewer buses.
